# 🤖 AI Workloads - WAF Discovery Workbook

A **one-click, read-only** Level 100/200 assessment of every AI-related Azure resource in the selected subscriptions, scored against the five **Well-Architected Framework** pillars.

- ✅ **Zero deployment cost** - uses Azure Resource Graph only (no Log Analytics, no agents).
- ✅ **Live data** - click the **🔄 Refresh** icon in the toolbar to re-evaluate at any time.
- ✅ **Stakeholder ready** - start at the scorecard, drill into pillars, export the findings list.

**Scope:** Azure OpenAI, AI Foundry, AI Services / Cognitive accounts, model deployments, Azure ML workspaces, AI Search services, online endpoints, and ML compute.

### 👔 Executive Summary

Use the scorecards below for an at-a-glance view of your **AI estate** and **risk posture** across the five Azure Well-Architected Framework pillars. On each pillar tile, the large red number is **High-severity** findings; the smaller number is **Total findings (High + Medium + Low)**.

> **How to use this workbook**
> 1. Pick subscriptions and (optionally) a name filter above.
> 2. Review the scorecards on this header band - they always reflect the current filter.
> 3. Drill into a pillar tab below for the underlying evidence.
> 4. Open the **📋 All Findings** tab for a single, exportable backlog.
> 5. Click the **🔄 Refresh** icon in the workbook toolbar at any time.

// === SHARED FINDINGS LOGIC — keep in sync via fix-issues.py ===
// Resource Graph does not index Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts/deployments,
// so model-deployment findings are intentionally absent. Use the 🕒 Model Lifecycle
// tab for live deployment data via ARM REST.
// ARG limits queries to 6 joins, so all 4 resource types are unioned first and the
// lock / PE / ML-child lookups are applied once via 3 leftouter joins.
resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts','microsoft.search/searchservices','microsoft.machinelearningservices/workspaces','microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts/projects')
| where ('{NameFilter}' == '' or name contains '{NameFilter}')
| extend _lowerId = tolower(id), _t = tolower(tostring(type))
| join kind=leftouter (
    resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.authorization/locks'
    | extend Scope = tolower(tostring(split(id,'/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/locks/')[0]))
    | summarize LockCount = count() by Scope
  ) on $left._lowerId == $right.Scope
| join kind=leftouter (
    resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.network/privateendpoints'
    | mv-expand conn = properties.privateLinkServiceConnections
    | extend TargetId = tolower(tostring(conn.properties.privateLinkServiceId))
    | summarize PeCount = count() by TargetId
  ) on $left._lowerId == $right.TargetId
| join kind=leftouter (
    resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.machinelearningservices/workspaces/onlineendpoints' or type =~ 'microsoft.machinelearningservices/workspaces/computes'
    | extend Parent = tostring(split(id,'/')[8])
    | summarize Children = count() by Parent
  ) on $left.name == $right.Parent
| extend _missingTags = set_difference(split('{RequiredTagKey}', ','), bag_keys(tags))
| extend _findings = pack_array(
    // Public network access (cognitive + search + ML)
    iff(_t in~ ('microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts','microsoft.search/searchservices','microsoft.machinelearningservices/workspaces') and tostring(properties.publicNetworkAccess) =~ 'Enabled',
        bag_pack('Pillar','Security','Severity','High','Check','Public network access is Enabled','Value',tostring(properties.publicNetworkAccess),'Recommendation','Disable public network access and use Private Endpoints + service-tag restrictions.','Doc','https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-services/cognitive-services-virtual-networks'), dynamic(null)),
    // Local auth (cognitive + search)
    iff(_t in~ ('microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts','microsoft.search/searchservices') and tobool(properties.disableLocalAuth) != true,
        bag_pack('Pillar','Security','Severity',iff(_t =~ 'microsoft.search/searchservices','Medium','High'),'Check','Local auth (API keys) enabled','Value','Enabled','Recommendation','Disable local auth and require Entra ID with managed identity / RBAC.','Doc','https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-services/authentication'), dynamic(null)),
    // PE-gap (cognitive + search + ML)
    iff(_t in~ ('microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts','microsoft.search/searchservices','microsoft.machinelearningservices/workspaces') and (isnull(PeCount) or PeCount == 0),
        bag_pack('Pillar','Security','Severity','Medium','Check','No Private Endpoint attached','Value','0 endpoints','Recommendation','Attach a Private Endpoint to keep traffic on the Microsoft backbone.','Doc','https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/private-link/private-endpoint-overview'), dynamic(null)),
    // CMK (cognitive only)
    iff(_t =~ 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts' and isnull(properties.encryption.keyVaultProperties),
        bag_pack('Pillar','Security','Severity','Medium','Check','No customer-managed key (CMK)','Value','Microsoft-managed','Recommendation','If compliance requires it, configure CMK in Key Vault for data at rest.','Doc','https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-services/encryption/cognitive-services-encryption-keys-portal'), dynamic(null)),
    // Managed identity (cognitive only)
    iff(_t =~ 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts' and (isempty(tostring(identity.type)) or tostring(identity.type) =~ 'None'),
        bag_pack('Pillar','Security','Severity','Medium','Check','No managed identity','Value','None','Recommendation','Assign system or user-assigned managed identity so dependencies use Entra ID, not keys.','Doc','https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/active-directory/managed-identities-azure-resources/overview'), dynamic(null)),
    // HBI (ML only)
    iff(_t =~ 'microsoft.machinelearningservices/workspaces' and tobool(properties.hbiWorkspace) != true,
        bag_pack('Pillar','Security','Severity','Low','Check','ML workspace not flagged as HBI','Value','hbiWorkspace=false','Recommendation','If workspace handles regulated data, enable High Business Impact at create time.','Doc','https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/machine-learning/concept-data-encryption'), dynamic(null)),
    // F0 SKU (cognitive only)
    iff(_t =~ 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts' and tostring(sku.name) =~ 'F0',
        bag_pack('Pillar','Reliability','Severity','High','Check','Free (F0) SKU in use - no SLA','Value','F0','Recommendation','Move production workloads to Standard (S0+) SKU for SLA coverage.','Doc','https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-services/cognitive-services-limited-access'), dynamic(null)),
    // Search replicas (search only)
    iff(_t =~ 'microsoft.search/searchservices' and toint(properties.replicaCount) < 2,
        bag_pack('Pillar','Reliability','Severity','High','Check','AI Search has <2 replicas','Value',tostring(toint(properties.replicaCount)),'Recommendation','Use 2+ replicas for read SLA, 3+ for read/write SLA.','Doc','https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/search/search-capacity-planning'), dynamic(null)),
    // Foundry project provisioning state (projects only)
    iff(_t =~ 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts/projects' and tostring(properties.provisioningState) !~ 'Succeeded',
        bag_pack('Pillar','Reliability','Severity','Medium','Check','Foundry project not in Succeeded state','Value',tostring(properties.provisioningState),'Recommendation','Investigate provisioning state; re-provision or delete the project.','Doc','https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-foundry/'), dynamic(null)),
    // Idle ML workspace (ML only)
    iff(_t =~ 'microsoft.machinelearningservices/workspaces' and (isnull(Children) or Children == 0),
        bag_pack('Pillar','Cost','Severity','Low','Check','ML workspace has no compute or endpoints','Value','0 children','Recommendation','Confirm workspace is in use; delete if abandoned.','Doc','https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/machine-learning/how-to-manage-workspace'), dynamic(null)),
    // Missing tags (all 4 types)
    iff(array_length(_missingTags) > 0,
        bag_pack('Pillar','Operational Excellence','Severity','Medium','Check',strcat('Missing required tag(s): ', strcat_array(_missingTags, ', ')),'Value','(empty)','Recommendation','Apply organizational tagging standard (Owner, CostCenter, Env).','Doc','https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-resource-manager/management/tag-resources'), dynamic(null)),
    // Missing lock (all 4 types)
    iff(isnull(LockCount) or LockCount == 0,
        bag_pack('Pillar','Operational Excellence','Severity','Low','Check','No resource lock','Value','0 locks','Recommendation','Apply a CanNotDelete lock on production AI resources to prevent accidental deletion.','Doc','https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-resource-manager/management/lock-resources'), dynamic(null)))
| mv-expand finding = _findings
| where isnotnull(finding) and tostring(finding) != ''
| project Resource=name, Type=type, Pillar=tostring(finding.Pillar), Severity=tostring(finding.Severity), Check=tostring(finding.Check), Value=tostring(finding.Value), Recommendation=tostring(finding.Recommendation), Doc=tostring(finding.Doc), Subscription=subscriptionId, ResourceGroup=resourceGroup, ResourceId=id

| summarize High = countif(Severity == 'High'), Medium = countif(Severity == 'Medium'), Low = countif(Severity == 'Low') by Pillar
| extend Total = High + Medium + Low
| extend Sort = case(Pillar == 'Security', 1, Pillar == 'Reliability', 2, Pillar == 'Cost', 3, Pillar == 'Operational Excellence', 4, 9)
| extend Icon = case(Pillar == 'Security', '🛡️', Pillar == 'Reliability', '🔄', Pillar == 'Cost', '💰', Pillar == 'Operational Excellence', '⚙️', '*')
| project Pillar = strcat(Icon, ' ', Pillar), High, Medium, Low, Total, Sort
| order by Sort asc
| project-away Sort
content.title: Risk Scorecard by WAF Pillar (large number = High-severity, subtitle = Total findings)

content.json:
## 🛡️ Security

**Stakeholder takeaway:** are AI services hardened against the public internet, identity-only (Entra ID, not API keys), and encrypted with customer-managed keys where required?

**What 'good' looks like for an AI workload:**
- 🟢 **Public network access = Disabled** + 🟢 **≥ 1 Private Endpoint**
- 🟢 **Local auth disabled** (API keys off, Entra ID only)
- 🟢 **Customer-managed key (CMK)** for sensitive / regulated data
- 🟢 **Managed Identity assigned** (System or User) so downstream calls don't need secrets
- 🟢 **Network ACL default = Deny** / **ML isolation = AllowOnlyApprovedOutbound**

Each row's **Risk** column counts how many of the above controls are missing — sort by Risk ⬇ to triage.

content.query:
resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts','microsoft.machinelearningservices/workspaces','microsoft.search/searchservices')
| where '{NameFilter}' == '' or name contains '{NameFilter}'
| extend pna = tostring(properties.publicNetworkAccess),
         dla = tobool(properties.disableLocalAuth),
         cmk = iif(type =~ 'microsoft.search/searchservices',
                   tostring(properties.encryptionWithCmk.enforcement) =~ 'Enabled',
                   isnotnull(properties.encryption.keyVaultProperties)),
         mi  = tostring(identity.type),
         pe  = iif(type =~ 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts',
                   coalesce(array_length(todynamic(tostring(properties.privateEndpointConnections))),0),
                   0)
| summarize
    Total = count(),
    PublicBlocked = countif(pna =~ 'Disabled'),
    KeysDisabled  = countif(dla == true),
    HasCMK        = countif(cmk),
    HasManagedId  = countif(isnotempty(mi) and mi !~ 'None'),
    HasPrivateEP  = countif(pe > 0)
| project Total, KPIs = pack(
    '🌐 Public access blocked', PublicBlocked,
    '🔑 Local auth keys disabled', KeysDisabled,
    '🔐 Customer-managed key', HasCMK,
    '🪪 Managed identity assigned', HasManagedId,
    '🛡️ Private endpoint attached', HasPrivateEP)
| mv-expand kv = KPIs
| extend KPI = tostring(bag_keys(kv)[0])
| extend Value = toint(kv[KPI])
| extend Score = strcat(Value, ' / ', Total),
         Status = case(Value == Total, '🟢', Value == 0, '🔴', '🟡')
| project KPI, Status, Score
| order by KPI asc
content.title: Security posture across all AI resources

content.json:
### 📊 Risk score legend

Each row's **Risk** column = number of failed checks (lower is better). Threshold colors: 🟢 **0** · 🟡 **1–2** · 🔴 **3+**.

| Check (one point each when failing) | 🤖 Cognitive / OpenAI | 🧪 Azure ML | 🔍 AI Search |
|---|:-:|:-:|:-:|
| Public network access ≠ **Disabled** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Local auth (API keys) not disabled | ✅ | — | ✅ |
| HBI workspace flag not set | — | ✅ | — |
| No customer-managed key (CMK) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ (`Enabled` enforcement) |
| No managed identity assigned | ✅ | ✅ | — |
| Zero private endpoints attached | ✅ | — | — |
| Network ACL default ≠ **Deny** | ✅ | — | — |
| Managed network isolation ≠ **AllowOnlyApprovedOutbound** | — | ✅ | — |
| Auth mode = **apiKeyOnly** (no Entra) | — | — | ✅ |

**Max possible Risk:** Cognitive = 6 · Azure ML = 5 · AI Search = 4. Sort the grid by **Risk ⬇** to triage worst offenders first.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts'
| where '{NameFilter}' == '' or name contains '{NameFilter}'
| extend _pna = tostring(properties.publicNetworkAccess),
         _dla = tobool(properties.disableLocalAuth),
         _cmk = isnotnull(properties.encryption.keyVaultProperties),
         _mi  = tostring(identity.type),
         _pe  = coalesce(array_length(todynamic(tostring(properties.privateEndpointConnections))), 0),
         _rob = tostring(properties.restrictOutboundNetworkAccess),
         _nda = tostring(properties.networkAcls.defaultAction)
| extend Risk = toint(iif(_pna =~ 'Enabled',1,0))
              + toint(iif(_dla == true,0,1))
              + toint(iif(_cmk,0,1))
              + toint(iif(isempty(_mi) or _mi =~ 'None',1,0))
              + toint(iif(_pe > 0,0,1))
              + toint(iif(_nda =~ 'Deny',0,1))
| project
    Name = name,
    Kind = tostring(kind),
    PublicAccess  = iif(_pna =~ 'Disabled', strcat('🟢 ', _pna), iif(isempty(_pna), '⚪ (not set)', strcat('🔴 ', _pna))),
    LocalAuth     = iif(_dla == true, '🟢 Keys disabled', '🔴 Keys enabled'),
    CMK           = iif(_cmk, '🟢 Yes', '🟡 No (platform key)'),
    ManagedId     = iif(isempty(_mi) or _mi =~ 'None', '🔴 None', strcat('🟢 ', _mi)),
    PrivateEP     = _pe,
    NetworkAcls   = case(_nda =~ 'Deny', '🟢 Deny', _nda =~ 'Allow', '🔴 Allow', '🟡 (not set)'),
    RestrictOut   = case(_rob =~ 'Enabled', '🟢 Enabled', _rob =~ 'Disabled', '🟡 Disabled', '⚪ (not set)'),
    Risk,
    ResourceGroup = resourceGroup,
    ResourceId    = id
| order by Risk desc, Name asc
content.title: AI / Cognitive Services account security posture

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.machinelearningservices/workspaces'
| where '{NameFilter}' == '' or name contains '{NameFilter}'
| extend _pna = tostring(properties.publicNetworkAccess),
         _hbi = tobool(properties.hbiWorkspace),
         _mi  = tostring(identity.type),
         _cmk = isnotnull(properties.encryption.keyVaultProperties),
         _iso = tostring(properties.managedNetwork.isolationMode)
| extend Risk = toint(iif(_pna =~ 'Enabled',1,0))
              + toint(iif(_hbi == true,0,1))
              + toint(iif(_cmk,0,1))
              + toint(iif(isempty(_mi) or _mi =~ 'None',1,0))
              + toint(iif(_iso =~ 'AllowOnlyApprovedOutbound',0,1))
| project
    Name = name,
    Kind = tostring(kind),
    PublicAccess = iif(_pna =~ 'Disabled', strcat('🟢 ', _pna), iif(isempty(_pna), '⚪ (not set)', strcat('🔴 ', _pna))),
    HBI          = iif(_hbi == true, '🟢 Yes (HBI)', '🟡 No'),
    CMK          = iif(_cmk, '🟢 Yes', '🟡 No (platform key)'),
    ManagedId    = iif(isempty(_mi) or _mi =~ 'None', '🔴 None', strcat('🟢 ', _mi)),
    NetworkIso   = case(
        _iso =~ 'AllowOnlyApprovedOutbound', '🟢 AllowOnlyApprovedOutbound',
        _iso =~ 'AllowInternetOutbound',     '🟡 AllowInternetOutbound',
        _iso =~ 'Disabled',                  '🔴 Disabled',
        isempty(_iso),                       '🔴 (none — managed VNet not configured)',
        strcat('⚪ ', _iso)),
    Risk,
    ResourceGroup = resourceGroup,
    ResourceId    = id
| order by Risk desc, Name asc
content.title: Azure ML / AI Foundry workspace security posture

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.search/searchservices'
| where '{NameFilter}' == '' or name contains '{NameFilter}'
| extend _pna  = tostring(properties.publicNetworkAccess),
         _dla  = tobool(properties.disableLocalAuth),
         _cmk  = tostring(properties.encryptionWithCmk.enforcement),
         _auth = properties.authOptions
| extend _authMode = case(
    isnotnull(_auth.aadOrApiKey),  'aadOrApiKey',
    isnotnull(_auth.aad),          'aad',
    isnotnull(_auth.apiKeyOnly),   'apiKeyOnly',
    _dla == true,                  'aad (local auth disabled)',
    'apiKeyOnly')

content.json:
## 🔄 Reliability

**Stakeholder takeaway:** are production AI workloads on SLA-backed SKUs, in zone-capable regions, and (for AI Search) with enough replicas for the read/write SLA?

**What 'good' looks like:**
- 🟢 **Cognitive / OpenAI**: SKU = `S0` or higher (F0 has no SLA), region supports **availability zones**
- 🟢 **AI Search**: SKU ≥ `standard` (basic/free can't use AZ), **Replicas ≥ 2** for read-SLA, **Replicas ≥ 3** for write-SLA, **Partitions ≥ 2** for index resilience
- 🟢 **ML Online Endpoints**: `Succeeded` provisioning, non-key auth, private network

Sort each grid by **Risk ⬇** to find the worst offenders.

content.query:
resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts','microsoft.search/searchservices','microsoft.machinelearningservices/workspaces/onlineendpoints')
| where '{NameFilter}' == '' or name contains '{NameFilter}'
| extend _sku = tostring(sku.name),
         _loc = tolower(location),
         _replicas = toint(properties.replicaCount),
         _isSearch = type =~ 'microsoft.search/searchservices',
         _isCog = type =~ 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts',
         _isEndpoint = type =~ 'microsoft.machinelearningservices/workspaces/onlineendpoints',
         _provState = tostring(properties.provisioningState)
| summarize
    Total       = count(),
    SLABacked   = countif((_isCog and _sku !~ 'F0' and isnotempty(_sku)) or (_isSearch and _sku !~ 'free' and _sku !~ 'basic') or (_isEndpoint and _provState =~ 'Succeeded')),
    ZoneCapable = countif(_loc in ('eastus','eastus2','westus2','westus3','westeurope','northeurope','francecentral','swedencentral','southcentralus','southeastasia','japaneast','australiaeast','uksouth','canadacentral','germanywestcentral','koreacentral','brazilsouth','centralindia')),
    SearchReadSLA  = countif(_isSearch and _replicas >= 2),
    SearchWriteSLA = countif(_isSearch and _replicas >= 3),
    SearchTotal    = countif(_isSearch),
    CogTotal       = countif(_isCog),
    CogPaid        = countif(_isCog and _sku !~ 'F0' and isnotempty(_sku))
| project KPIs = pack(
    '🪙 Production SKU (SLA-backed)', SLABacked,
    '🌐 In zone-capable region',      ZoneCapable,
    '📚 AI Search read-SLA (≥2 reps)', SearchReadSLA,
    '✍️ AI Search write-SLA (≥3 reps)', SearchWriteSLA,
    '🤖 Cognitive on paid tier',      CogPaid),
  Denominators = pack(
    '🪙 Production SKU (SLA-backed)', Total,
    '🌐 In zone-capable region',      Total,
    '📚 AI Search read-SLA (≥2 reps)', SearchTotal,
    '✍️ AI Search write-SLA (≥3 reps)', SearchTotal,
    '🤖 Cognitive on paid tier',      CogTotal)
| mv-expand kv = KPIs
| extend KPI = tostring(bag_keys(kv)[0])
| extend Value = toint(kv[KPI]), Total = toint(Denominators[KPI])
| extend Score = strcat(Value, ' / ', Total),
         Status = case(Total == 0, '⚪', Value == Total, '🟢', Value == 0, '🔴', '🟡')
| project KPI, Status, Score
| order by KPI asc
content.title: Reliability posture across all AI resources

Each row's **Risk** column = number of failed checks (lower is better). Colors: 🟢 **0** · 🟡 **1–2** · 🔴 **3+**.

💡 **Reading this table:** each row is one of your deployments joined with one published catalog version of that model. If a model has multiple published versions in your region, the deployment appears once per version — **find the row where `Catalog version` equals your `Deployed version`** to read the retirement date that actually applies to your deployment. Empty `Lifecycle` / retirement columns mean the deployed model name was not found in the regional catalog (custom or third-party model).

**Lifecycle status — what each value means** (from the `Microsoft.CognitiveServices/.../models` API):

| Status | Meaning | Retirement dates? |
|---|---|---|
| 🟢 **GA** (`GenerallyAvailable`) | Production-ready **Azure OpenAI proprietary** model (e.g. `gpt-4o`, `gpt-5`, `text-embedding-3-*`, `dall-e-3`). Has an SLA. Each `(model, version)` has an **explicit retirement date** published ≥ 6 months in advance. | ✅ Yes — see `Inference retirement` / `Fine-tune retirement` |
| 🟢 **Stable** | Production-ready **open-source or partner-hosted** model on Microsoft Foundry (e.g. `Phi-*`, `FLUX*`, `Mistral-*`, `Llama-*`, `DeepSeek-*`). No version-based deprecation schedule — replaced as newer releases ship; old versions may be removed without a dated notice. | ❌ Usually empty — track the model's [Foundry catalog page](https://ai.azure.com/explore/models) for updates |
| 🔵 **Preview** | Early-access / public-preview model. **No SLA**; APIs, prompts, or outputs may change. Not for production workloads. | ❌ N/A — may be promoted to GA/Stable or removed |
| 🟠 **Deprecating** | On the retirement path. **Existing deployments continue to work** until `Inference retirement`. New deployments may be blocked. | ✅ Yes — migrate now |
| 🔴 **Retired** (`Deprecated`) | Fully removed. Inference calls return **HTTP 410 Gone**. | ⚠️ Past — must migrate immediately |

**Bottom line:** if you see 🟢 **GA**, plan migrations to the retirement date column. If you see 🟢 **Stable**, the column will be empty — that's expected for Phi / FLUX / Mistral / Llama-class models; check the Foundry catalog instead. 🟠/🔴 = act now.

**References:** [Azure OpenAI model retirement policy](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-services/openai/concepts/model-retirements) · [Foundry model catalog](https://ai.azure.com/explore/models)
